page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top, then one block of main text in a single column, ending with a catchword at the lower right. Below the text is a large woodcut initial with show-through from the reverse side, which is not transcribed. No margin notes.

main_text.p: plicitate collegerunt, aliisque tradiderunt, viri boni hac tamen in parte non satis cauti: IX. Tandem ex eo quòd, iis positis fundamentis, horrendum ædificium invectæ in Ecclesiam tyrannidis superstructum est, Satanæ patris mendacii, & fabularum in hoc argumento multiplicatarum authoris præcipui, patefacere dolos & artes, quibus quod occultè initio peragebatur iniquitatis mysterium confectum reddidit: & illi quidem promovendo multos minimè malos aliquam operam contulisse imprudentes, eòque utcúmque excusandos esse; Nunc verò, quando res in propatulo est, id operis quocúmque modo foventem, ut apertum veritatis divinæ & libertatis Ecclesiasticæ hostem Σκόμαχον[?] videri.

page.notes: The woodcut initial below the text and the ghosted lines under it are show-through from the reverse side and were left out. The Greek word at the end of the paragraph is read with doubt: Σκόμαχον[?]. The catchword "LIBER-" is taken as the start of the next word on the following page.
